fix(M0): canonicalize proposal paths without rewriting J0 history

M0 executes P1-D15 under P1-F36. J0's observer stored write paths literally,
so 33/110 proposals carried an absolute path while the oracle keyed on
root-relative paths; those rows scored truth.known === false and were excluded
from the confusion matrix. The defect was in measurement, not in any gate.

The unknown rows had four distinct causes that must not be pooled:
(a) an absolute path that does map inside the trial root -- the defect M0 fixes;
(b) a path that genuinely escapes the trial root -- path_out_of_root, a security
    observation independent of compliance, never labelled compliant or not;
(c) inside the root but outside src/**/*.js -- outside_frozen_scope, an oracle
    boundary that M0 cannot and should not remove;
(d) inside scope but unparseable -- syntax_outside_oracle, also an oracle
    boundary.
Only (a) is repaired. (c) and (d) remain unknown with their own reason codes.

Changes:
- harness/path-mapping.mjs canonicalizes against the trial root with lexical
  containment first, then realpath containment so a symlink cannot escape.
  Missing final files map; dangling symlinks become path_ambiguous.
- harness/runner.mjs keeps args.path byte-identical and adds canonicalPath and
  canonicalFailure beside it, so audit still sees what the model wrote.
- harness/remap-proposals.mjs recomputes the 110 J0 formal rows read-only.
- Six fixtures cover relative, absolute-inside, absolute-outside,
  symlink-inside, symlink-outside, and duplicate-path spellings.

Ran:
- node harness/check-path-mapping.mjs: 6/6 fixtures passed; the out-of-root
  sample classifies as canonicalPath null, path_out_of_root, known false,
  compliant false -- it is not scored either way
- node harness/remap-proposals.mjs: 110 rows, 33 raw absolute paths, 33 mapped,
  110 canonical non-null, 0 path_out_of_root, 0 path_ambiguous, 0
  outside_frozen_scope, 0 syntax_outside_oracle
- git diff --stat results/: empty; all 110 archived proposals byte-unchanged
- node --check on all four harness files: pass

The 33 historical unknown rows are not relabelled and no historical conclusion
moves. J0 remains a partial integration baseline.
